name: Minesweeper 2P Turn Relay & Sudden Death
description: Verify multiplayer turn-passing, bitboard scoring, and sudden-death elimination across two VMs

steps.desc: Ensure vm-01 (Seat P1) is initialized at 390×844 Mobile Portrait
Ensure vm-02 (Seat P2) is initialized at 390×844 Mobile Portrait
Enable side-by-side split view mode
Open Minesweeper on vm-01 (Seat P1)
Open Minesweeper on vm-02 (Seat P2)
Configure vm-01 as Seat P1 (Seed 42, Max Strikes 1) on Match #101
Configure vm-02 as Seat P2 (Seed 42, Max Strikes 1) on Match #101
Assert vm-01 turn is P1
Assert vm-02 turn is P1
P1 (vm-01): Reveal safe cell at (0, 0)
Wait for broker event relay
Assert points awarded to P1 on vm-01
Assert points synchronized to P2 on vm-02 via broker RX
Assert turn passed to P2 on vm-01
Assert turn passed to P2 on vm-02
P2 (vm-02): Reveal safe cell at (0, 7)
Wait for broker event relay
Assert points awarded to P2 on vm-02
Assert points synchronized to P1 on vm-01 via broker RX

steps.label: Minesweeper 2P Turn Relay - Safe Paths Dual View
steps.desc: Capture dual-perspective split snapshot of both safe territories
P1 (vm-01): Reveal known bomb cell at (0, 6) triggering sudden-death
Wait for broker event relay
Assert sudden-death elimination on vm-01 (Winner is P2)
Assert sudden-death elimination synced to vm-02 (Winner is P2)
